onboarding_slide1_text: Here you color the selected contour. Let's take a quick look at what's here.
onboarding_slide2_text: Drag your finger or stylus across the canvas to draw. Some brushes respond to stylus pressure — press harder for a thicker stroke.
onboarding_slide3_text: Top of the left panel — switch between brush and eraser. The eraser only removes your strokes, the contour stays untouched.
onboarding_slide4_text: Two sliders under the brush: top one for size, bottom one for opacity. Drag up or down to adjust.
onboarding_slide5_text: Use two fingers to zoom and pan. If you get lost — tap the reset icon, and the canvas returns to its original position.
onboarding_slide6_text: Undo and Redo buttons at the bottom left. You can undo up to 5 steps and redo them back.
onboarding_slide7_text: Tap the color circle in the bottom panel to open the palette. Pick any hue, adjust opacity, or enter a HEX code. The eyedropper tool lets you grab a color directly from the canvas.
onboarding_slide8_text: Tap the tools icon at the bottom to choose a brush — from classic round to a fine liner. Pick the right one for your task.
onboarding_slide9_text: You can change the color and opacity of the outline. Make it lighter if it's distracting, or change the color for a different look.
onboarding_slide10_text: Tap Share in the top-right to save your artwork or send it to friends. And if you ever forget how something works — tap the ⓘ icon next to Share to see this guide again.
